capabilities: format code in notes via commands
format JSON, YAML, HTML, GraphQL and TypeScript
extras: The How to use section is empty; until the plugin is published in the community directory it must be installed manually by cloning the repository and building it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in commands to format code inside notes, so malformed code blocks must be cleaned up externally.
summary: Adds commands that format code blocks in JSON, YAML, HTML, GraphQL and TypeScript, using Prettier under the hood.
